title: Autumn Term News & Fireworks Tickets
summary: Committee news, autumn dates, Fireworks details and ways to help The FOA.

sections.title: Dear Parents, Carers and Teachers,
paragraphs: Last year, the incredible generosity of Ashley families helped us raise a phenomenal £25,730. That hard work is about to pay off in the best possible way: our brand-new KS1 playground equipment is scheduled to be installed over the October half term!
That certainly sets the bar high, but can we beat it together this year? Here is a quick look at what is coming up this term, key dates for your diary and easy ways to get involved.

sections.title: 👥 The Friends of Ashley (FOA) Committee 2026/27
paragraphs: Every parent, carer and teacher at Ashley is automatically a member of The FOA. You do not need an official title to help out, but our confirmed committee for this year is:
list: **Co-Chairs:** Helen Platt & Sarah Parish
**Co-Treasurers:** Clare Birks & Darren Malone
**Co-Comms:** Nick Caplan & Cristy Amponsah
**Fundraising Initiatives Lead:** Lizzie Grillo
**Co-Secretary:** **Vacant** (*Could this be you?*)

sections.title: ♥️ A Heartfelt Thank You to Sarah and Katy
paragraphs: At the AGM, we said an emotional farewell to **Sarah Parker and Katy Furber**, who have officially stepped down at Co-Comms and Co-Secretary after collectively dedicating almost 10 years of service to The FOA Committee!
Between coordinating major events, raising vital funds and championing our school community year after year, their contribution has made an enormous, lasting impact on Ashley and our children.
We want to extend our deepest gratitude for their extraordinary hard work, energy and dedication. They leave very big shoes to fill and will be hugely missed on the committee!

sections.title: 🌟 Committee & Volunteer Shout-Outs: Could you be our Co-Secretary?
paragraphs: A manageable, flexible way to help with agendas and meeting minutes behind the scenes. Drop us a line at [thefriendsofashley@gmail.com](mailto:thefriendsofashley@gmail.com) if you would like to know more or share the role with a friend.
list: **Christmas Fayre:** A huge thank you to **Rachel Briscoe and Sophie Glass** for stepping forward to lead this year's event!
**Fireworks 2027:** If you are interested in running next year's fireworks, please contact **Helen Platt** to shadow this year's event and learn the ropes with zero pressure.
**AGM Minutes:** You can [download the 16th September AGM minutes](https://www.ashleyschool.org.uk/assets/FOA/FOA_AGM_Minutes_16_SEPT_-2026.docx.pdf).

sections.title: 👕 Pre-loved Uniform Sales: 3:25pm, School Playground
paragraphs: *Coats and new-logo items: £3. All other items: £1. Card-only.*
Need uniform between sales? Fill out the [online request form](https://tinyurl.com/foapreloved) or email foapreloveduniform@gmail.com.

sections.title: ☕ Reception Welcome Tea: Saturday 3rd October on the School Field
paragraphs: A warm welcome to our new Ashley families! Join us on Saturday 3rd October to meet other parents and learn more about The FOA.
list: **Timings:** 1pm - 2:30pm

sections.title: 🎨 IQ Cards Christmas Project (October to December)
paragraphs: Children can design their own Christmas cards and gifts to raise money for The FOA!
list: **Design Sheets:** Sent home in bags by **Friday 2nd October** (completed either in class or as homework; your teacher will confirm).
**Return Deadline:** Return home-completed artwork to school by **Wednesday 14th October**.

**Design Tips:** Draw on the blank side only (do not photocopy; each sheet has a unique code). Fill the space with bold, bright colours (paint, felt-tips and colouring pencils work best). Avoid glitter, metallic pens, plain lead pencil or stuck-on items.
**Ordering:** Personalised order forms will be sent home once designs are processed for online ordering and payment. Orders will arrive at school in early December.

sections.title: 🎆 Fireworks on the Field: Thursday 5th November
paragraphs: Join us for our annual spectacular evening of fireworks, food and fun on the school field!
list: **Timings:** 16:30 to 18:30 (Quiet display at 17:00; Main display at 18:00)
**Tickets:** £8.50 per person (under 2 years free). Online ticket link will be shared shortly.
**Attractions:** Fairground, food stalls and mulled wine!
**Details:** See the attached poster for full details.
**Lead:** Helen Platt

sections.title: 🎄 Christmas Fayre: Saturday 5th December
paragraphs: Save the date for our biggest winter celebration! Rachel Briscoe and Sophie Glass will share details soon regarding class stalls, donations and volunteer sign-ups.

sections.title: 📱 The Friends of Ashley website has been refreshed!
paragraphs: We have updated our online home at [The Friends of Ashley](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/) to make it easier for Ashley families to find what they need. The refreshed site brings together upcoming events, uniform information, opportunities to get involved and community notices in one simple, welcoming place. Take a look!
